subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which gives the meaning of the given idiom or phrase.
To strain at a gnat and swallow a camel

options.text: To have a very large appetite
To fuss over trifles while ignoring big issues

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **To fuss over trifles while ignoring big issues**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To strain at a gnat and swallow a camel"** refers to someone who gets overly concerned with minor or insignificant issues (trifles) while overlooking or accepting much larger and significant problems. (छोटी बातों पर ध्यान देना और बड़ी बातों को नज़रअंदाज़ करना) • **Example:** The manager kept pointing out typos in the report but ignored the fact that the entire strategy was flawed. Truly, he was straining at a gnat and swallowing a camel. • **Correct Explanation:** The meaning of the idiom emphasizes misplaced priorities or focusing on trivial details while ignoring serious matters. (गंभीर मुद्दों को नज़रअंदाज़ करते हुए छोटी-छोटी बातों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना) • **Example:** The government is busy debating minor reforms while ignoring the major economic crisis. They are straining at a gnat and swallowing a camel. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **To fuss over trifles while ignoring big issues**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To be extremely physically weak** (अत्यधिक शारीरिक रूप से कमजोर होना) • **Example:** After recovering from the illness, she felt extremely physically weak and needed rest. • **Option 2: To have a very large appetite** (बहुत बड़ी भूख होना) • **Example:** Teenagers often have a very large appetite due to their growing bodies. • **Option 4: To be meticulous in everything** (हर चीज में बहुत ही सावधानीपूर्वक होना) • **Example:** She is meticulous in everything she does, from her work to her daily routine. 9a:T12fa, The correct answer is **Option 4**.
